name: Touma Kazusa
source: Third-year student at Houjou High School who is in the same class as Haruki. While a musical genius, she’s habitually late to school and rarely pays attention during class, resulting in abysmal grades. Combined with her antisocial nature and dismissive attitude toward others, she’s ostracized by classmates and teachers alike.
